title: Deep learning-driven morphological fingerprinting: rapid, accurate and low-cost pathogen identification via the analysis of dried patterns of droplets.
summary: A deep-learning image classifier used dried microbial droplet patterns for pathogen identification; the full-text Results compare performance across tested species and support a rapid identification proof of concept.
ai_technology: Deep-learning image classification identifies pathogens from dried microbial droplet patterns.
organization: Microbiome Medicine Center, Department of Laboratory Medicine, Zhujiang Hospital, Southern Medical University, Guangzhou, 510260, China

evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
